author: floorv541

title: Super fun and simple!
text: Amazing experience! Easy process with Julia who provided the board, paddle, and instructions. I rented a waterproof phone case for 8 euro. They provide a free locker to store your things which is great (can hold about 2 bags). It was wonderful to paddle board at 10am right before it got too hot. It was a lot of fun for a great price! Be sure to contact the tour operator for the specific time you want to come during business hours they are pretty flexible
